name: Disneyland Carnation Cafe Warm Spiced Apple Pie à la Mode
searchKeywords: disneyland apple pie a la mode
whyItWorks: Sliced apples baked tender with cinnamon, sugar, and flaky pastry crust, topped with vanilla ice cream. Baking breaks down apple cellulose, making it soft and low-residue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Apple Pie warm with vanilla ice cream; take lactase enzymes if dairy sensitive.
watchOuts: Contains dairy in the ice cream
